Class DbDemoService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.DbDemoService
public class DbDemoService extends Object
Facade powering the database demo tooling and integration scenarios that exercise cohesive workflows.

TaDatabase remains reachable for raw JSON-table inspection, while higher-level helpers delegate to ResumeService, JobService, ApplicationService, and MatchingService to keep business rules aligned with production paths.
